config_contents.description: Neural network, second stage (docs/54): SST indices and rainfall regions (with a regions-only control), the DRN refitted on the same folds, a neural correction of EMOS and a forecast-only ablation, January-initialized FMAM.
config_contents.external_note: The DRN is refitted here (same folds, years and seeds as the first stage, so the same networks), so that every comparison uses the same scoring rule (scoring version 2: CRPS split at the observation, closed form for the censored shifted gamma); drn_sst against drn_regions isolates the SST indices. Quantile regression is refitted too (diagnostic): the method selection decided between it and the DRN for JJAS September amounts on a margin smaller than the scoring error of the earlier rule.

provenance.uncommitted_check: code and configuration files this result depends on

pathway: B: rainfall-distribution models from the raw ensemble

emos_csg.name: EMOS, censored shifted gamma
emos_csg.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero
emos_csg.predictors: ensemble mean m' and mean absolute difference md' (relative)

quantile_regression.name: Regularized quantile regression
quantile_regression.estimates: conditional quantiles at 19 levels (5–95%), CDF by interpolation
quantile_regression.predictors: ensemble mean m' and spread s' (relative)
quantile_regression.fitting: pinball loss per level (Huber-smoothed), L2 1e-4, pooled

drn_csg.name: Distributional regression network (DRN), censored shifted gamma
drn_csg.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_csg.predictors: m', ensemble median, s', md', ensemble 10% and 90% quantiles (relative), log climatological mean, CHIRPS coefficient of variation, latitude, longitude
drn_csg.fitting: shared MLP (32 or 32-16 ELU units) -> CSG parameters; CRPS + weight decay; early stopping on held-out years; architecture and decay by validation CRPS, pooled

drn_regions.name: DRN with rainfall regions, no SST (control of drn_sst)
drn_regions.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_regions.predictors: the DRN inputs and the EMI rainfall regions (one-hot), no SST
drn_regions.fitting: as the DRN; separates the contribution of the SST indices from that of the regions

drn_sst.name: DRN with SST indices and rainfall regions
drn_sst.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_sst.predictors: the DRN inputs, SEAS5 Nino 3.4 and Indian Ocean Dipole indices of the target months, EMI rainfall regions (Korecha & Sorteberg 2013, one-hot)

drn_emos_residual.name: Neural correction of EMOS (censored shifted gamma)
drn_emos_residual.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_emos_residual.predictors: the DRN inputs; EMOS (mean and mean absolute difference) as the base
drn_emos_residual.fitting: EMOS by maximum likelihood, then a network added to its linear predictors, starting at zero, with a penalty on the correction; CRPS, early stopping on held-out years

drn_forecast_only.name: DRN on the ensemble only (no climatology or location; ablation)
drn_forecast_only.estimates: rainfall distribution with a probability of zero (mixture of 3 seeds)
drn_forecast_only.predictors: m', ensemble median, s', md', ensemble 10% and 90% quantiles (relative); no local context

references.incumbent: MVS -> smoothed counts -> climatology blend (published probabilities)

accepted.note: second stage: DRN with SST indices and EMI regions, regions-only control, neural correction of EMOS, forecast-only ablation, and the DRN, EMOS and quantile regression refitted on the same folds; CRPS scoring version 2. The folds were computed with the code of e4847a0; the final assembly of each cycle failed on a missing SCORING_VERSION constant and was completed from the checkpoints with the constant set (nothing refitted; code files unchanged, so the checkpoint keys matched)
